text.arabic_uthmani: إِن يَشَأْ يُسْكِنِ ٱلرِّيحَ فَيَظْلَلْنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍۢ شَكُورٍ

words.gloss_range: conditional particle opening a jussive protasis and placing the maritime scene under contingency
words.prose: {{ar:إِن}} ({{tr:in}}) opens the ayah by putting the whole maritime display under an if-frame. The stilled wind and stranded ships are therefore not narrated as a current disaster; they are presented as a possible dependency test. Coming after 42:32, the particle converts already displayed moving ships into contingent ships whose motion can be withheld.

topics.headline: open condition over the maritime sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the scene is introduced as possible dependency, not as a completed report of disaster.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark a conditional particle governing the jussive chain, so the stilling and result stay inside contingency.

topics.headline: prior moving ships become contingent ships
topics.reader_payoff: The reader carries the ships from 42:32 into a new frame where their motion is no longer autonomous.
topics.reason: The boundary rows explicitly connect 42:32 with the opening condition, and the next verbs supply the conditional mechanism.

words.gloss_range: jussive volition verb with omitted object supplied by the following stilling clause
words.root_gloss_range: root range links willing, determinative choice, and thingness; the local jussive selects divine volition inside a condition
words.prose: {{ar:يَشَأْ}} ({{tr:yashaʾ}}) is the first finite verb, so volition enters before wind, ships, or sign-language. Its jussive form keeps the act hypothetical under the opening condition, and its object is left compressed for the following stilling verb to supply. The root {{ar:ش ي أ}} ({{tr:sh-y-ʾ}}) makes the stopped voyage a selected possible state rather than random weather, while will-sign co-occurrence ties that selected suspension to the final signs. Its clipped hamza ending audibly marks the decision point, with 36:43 showing another sea-limit under divine will.

topics.headline: jussive willing with the object left unspoken
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the wished content is compressed and then specified by the stilling that follows.
topics.reason: The verb instance marks an omitted object and jussive dependence under the condition, while the next verb supplies the recoverable content.

topics.headline: will makes the stopped voyage determinate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees environmental change as downstream from selected will, not from autonomous physical causation.
topics.reason: The root field supports volition and determinate thingness, and local syntax places physical causation after this verb.

topics.headline: first finite verb governs wind and ships downstream
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that weather and vessels unfold only after the governing choice has been installed.
topics.reason: The protasis verb precedes the stilling apodosis and result scene, making the visible physics structurally downstream.

topics.headline: will-sign recurrence and clipped decision point
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear and compare the decision point: this passage suspends motion, while 36:43 imagines drowning under will.
topics.reason: The rows supply concrete recurrence links, including 36:43 and same-surah will language, while the final hamza observation remains a local sound payoff.

words.gloss_range: causative jussive verb making the wind settle as the conditionally willed result
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers stillness, settling, dwelling, rest, and tranquility; the local Form IV makes the wind enter caused quiet
words.prose: {{ar:يُسْكِنِ}} ({{tr:yuskini}}) turns will into altered physics. As a causative Form IV jussive, it makes the wind the acted-upon medium rather than the autonomous cause of stillness. The root {{ar:س ك ن}} ({{tr:s-k-n}}) brings settling, rest, and dwelling-like quiet into the scene: the moving medium is made to assume rest, and that caused rest becomes the condition that leaves the ships stranded. The final connecting kasra keeps the clipped jussive running into its object, while stillness itself becomes part of the ayah's sign-bearing mode.

topics.headline: the wind is made still, not self-stilling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that agency has moved away from the wind: the natural medium is acted upon.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify a transitive Form IV verb with the wind as direct object.

topics.headline: rest and dwelling imagery applied to motion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the wind not annihilated but made to settle into a state of quiet.
topics.reason: The root family supports stillness, rest, dwelling, and tranquility, locally narrowed to caused wind-stilling.

topics.headline: unseen choice becomes visible strandedness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the mechanism from divine choice to altered wind to visible immobility.
topics.reason: The clause sequence makes this verb the pivot between the protasis and the ships remaining stagnant.

topics.headline: the clipped jussive runs into sign-bearing stillness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the stilling verb remains syntactically connected to its object and pragmatically connected to the sign claim.
topics.reason: The liaison-kasra row and sign co-occurrence row are locally compatible with the jussive verb and final sign clause.

words.gloss_range: definite accusative wind noun as the controlled medium through which ships are immobilized
words.root_gloss_range: root field touches wind, breath, relief, and animation; the local noun selects weather-wind while retaining invisible enabling force as pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلرِّيحَ}} ({{tr:al-rīḥa}}) names the controlled medium before the ships are resumed. Its accusative position makes the wind the patient of stilling, so the vessels are immobilized indirectly through what normally carries them. The root {{ar:ر و ح}} ({{tr:r-w-ḥ}}) is locally weather-wind, but its breath and relief range keeps the enabling current life-like; accepted singular and plural readings vary the scale of the wind-field without moving control away from divine will. Against wind-ship passages where wind enables sailing (30:46; 10:22), its withdrawal here makes propulsion legible as favor and a trigger for gratitude.

topics.headline: wind as direct object and enabling medium
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ships stop because their medium is controlled, not because the ships themselves are first named as objects.
topics.reason: The direct-object attachment fixes the wind as the affected medium after the causative verb.

topics.headline: weather-wind with breath-like enabling pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader senses ordinary wind as an invisible enabling force, while the maritime grammar keeps weather-wind as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The broader breath and relief field is real, but the direct object of stilling in a maritime scene narrows the local sense to weather-wind.

topics.headline: one wind-force or multiple winds, same controlled medium
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that variant scale changes the wind-field from unified to distributed without changing who controls it.
topics.reason: The base reading is singular in the bundle, while the accepted plural variant broadens meteorological scope but does not alter the verb-object relation.

topics.headline: the wind-ship formula is proved by absence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a medium normally read as favor becomes legible precisely when it is withheld, as in the contrast with 30:46 and 10:22.
topics.reason: The rows give wind, gratitude, and ship-formula evidence, including 30:46 and 10:22, and the local scene specializes that pattern by stilling the wind.

words.gloss_range: result conjunction tightly linking stilling of the wind to the ships remaining motionless
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the tight result hinge. It makes the following remaining-state the consequence of the wind's stilling rather than a fresh report. Because the particle is prefixed to the next verb, the listener hears the result arriving before the ships' exact stagnant condition is named, compressing will, stilling, and visible stranding into one sequence.

topics.headline: stilled wind immediately yields the ships result
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ships do not retain independent momentum after the wind is stilled.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark a prefixed result conjunction beginning the result sequence.

topics.headline: consequence is fused to the verb that displays stagnation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the structural turn from altered medium into visible stranded vessels.
topics.reason: The rows focus on proclitic fusion, the visual pivot into stagnation, and the boundary shift from 42:32 into conditional-result verbs.

words.gloss_range: jussive feminine-plural continuance verb whose subject is the ships recovered from 42:32
words.root_gloss_range: root range includes remaining, continuing, shade, and being held under a state; the local verb selects durative remaining in a result clause
words.prose: {{ar:يَظْلَلْنَ}} ({{tr:yaẓlalna}}) brings the ships back without renaming them. Its feminine-plural subject has to be recovered from 42:32, so the previous visible ships cross the ayah boundary through verb morphology. The root {{ar:ظ ل ل}} ({{tr:ẓ-l-l}}) selects remaining or continuing in a state: the stilling is stretched into endured immobility, not left as a single instant of stopping. That durative pressure can carry a held-under shade, with 26:4 as a contrast for remaining under sign-pressure; the vowel variant marks recited surface without replacing the local parse.

topics.headline: feminine plural verb recovers the ships from 42:32
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah depends grammatically on the ships already shown in 42:32.
topics.reason: The 3FP verb is controlled by the ships from the prior ayah, and the bundle explicitly marks that implicit subject.

topics.headline: remaining turns stilling into endured condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the sign in prolonged helplessness, not merely in the moment motion stops.
topics.reason: The imperfect jussive and copular predicate frame make the ships remain in a state completed by the following predicate.

topics.headline: shade-family and variant pressure around a durative verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader may sense a held-under condition and cross-reference pressure, while the canonical local parse remains simple durative remaining.
topics.reason: The shade-family and 26:4 comparison enrich the continuance idea, and the non-canonical vowel variant is only apparatus; it does not replace the local consonantal frame.

words.gloss_range: feminine-plural active participle predicate naming the ships as stagnant and motionless
words.root_gloss_range: root range names stagnation, non-flow, and inert cessation; the local participle makes the ships visibly motionless as an ongoing state
words.prose: {{ar:رَوَاكِدَ}} ({{tr:rawākida}}) finally names what the recovered ships remain as: stagnant. Its participial predicate agrees with the feminine-plural subject, confirming that the ships, not the singular wind, are now the motionless bodies. The root {{ar:ر ك د}} ({{tr:r-k-d}}) gives the image more than a pause; it evokes non-flow and functional inertness, a rare participial state that makes the sign visible as arrested movement on the sea. The hard k-d close reinforces the arrest, and the landmark-like visibility from 42:32 returns as ships conspicuous because they are stuck.

topics.headline: predicate identifies the hidden ships condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader learns the exact state in which the recovered ships remain.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the word as the accusative predicate of the continuance verb, agreeing with the ships.

topics.headline: travel is converted into non-flow
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees vessels built for movement reduced to stagnant bodies.
topics.reason: The root field supports stagnation and non-flow, locally applied to vessels after the wind is stilled.

topics.headline: rare active participle makes the state marked
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah chooses a marked stagnation word where ordinary motion language has been inverted.
topics.reason: The distribution rows mark the root or form as singularly salient, and the participle presents stagnation as a sustained condition.

topics.headline: visible landmark becomes visibly stuck
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the reversal from conspicuous moving landmarks in 42:32 to conspicuous immobility here.
topics.reason: The boundary rows connect 42:32 landmark visibility with this stalled visibility, while the sound rows treat the hard close as local acoustic payoff.

words.gloss_range: surface preposition locating the stalled ships upon the sea rather than merely in it
words.prose: {{ar:عَلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ʿalā}}) turns the stagnant state into a surface picture. It governs the following noun and places the ships upon the sea's exposed plane, not merely inside a location called sea. That uponness lets contact and burden converge: the stranded vessels sit as weight on a visible surface.

topics.headline: uponness locates stagnation on an exposed plane
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees immobility spatially displayed on a surface rather than abstractly reported.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the following surface noun and selects an exposed-surface relation rather than a submerged or generic location.

topics.headline: ships rest as weight on the sea surface
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ships as a load borne on the sea, not only as vehicles lacking speed.
topics.reason: The semantic rows allow contact and burden values, and the local governed phrase supports the ships resting on the sea surface.

words.gloss_range: genitive surface noun with suffix referring back to the sea from 42:32
words.root_gloss_range: root range spans back, outward surface, appearance, and manifestation; the local noun selects the sea as an exposed upper surface
words.prose: {{ar:ظَهْرِهِ}} ({{tr:ẓahrihi}}) completes the surface image by carrying the sea from 42:32 in a suffix. The ayah does not repeat the sea noun; it compresses it into the possessive ending and makes the listener recover the prior maritime frame. The root {{ar:ظ ه ر}} ({{tr:ẓ-h-r}}) narrows from broad appearing and outwardness into a concrete back-like surface, so the hidden depth of the sea becomes readable through its upper face.

topics.headline: sea antecedent crosses as a suffix from 42:32
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the maritime setting is rebuilt by bound morphology rather than by repeating the sea noun.
topics.reason: The suffix has no local noun antecedent and must refer back to the sea in 42:32.

topics.headline: sea becomes a back-like support surface
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the sea as a bearing plane on which helpless ships are displayed.
topics.reason: The governed genitive noun selects the concrete back or upper exterior sense under the surface preposition.

topics.headline: appearance-root narrowed into exposed exterior
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices broad manifestation language turned into a physical location where the sign can be seen.
topics.reason: The rows compare broad manifestation uses such as 9:33 with the local concrete noun, and the surface later becomes available to every qualified reader.

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle shifting the ayah from conditional scene to asserted interpretation
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) pivots from the conditional sea scene to asserted interpretation. The ayah stops adding physical sequence and begins an emphatic nominal claim about what the scene contains. Its force is strengthened by the later emphatic marker, so the sign-status of the stalled ships is not offered as incidental weather but as the required reading of the scene. The doubled nun makes that shift to assertion audible before the sign noun arrives.

topics.headline: conditional event becomes asserted interpretation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the turn from picturing possible stagnation to reading it as evidence.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks an emphatic nominal clause after the conditional/result sequence.

topics.headline: emphasis begins before the sign noun arrives
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final claim as reinforced before the signs are named.
topics.reason: The rows connect this particle with the later emphatic marker and also note the audible compression of the assertion onset.

words.gloss_range: fronted container preposition making the described event the locus of signs
words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) makes the whole preceding case the place where signs are found. By fronting the prepositional phrase, the ayah asks the listener to hold the event-domain before the sign noun appears. The containment is interpretive rather than physical: evidence is housed in the condition, stilling, stagnation, and surface display together.

topics.headline: event-domain is foregrounded before signs are named
topics.reader_payoff: The reader holds the scene first and only then receives its classification as signs.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the demonstrative in a fronted predicate phrase before the delayed sign noun.

topics.headline: the conditional case becomes a sign-space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the signs are located in the whole scenario, not in one isolated physical object.
topics.reason: The rows consistently treat the preposition as locating evidence within the just-described event-chain.

words.gloss_range: distal demonstrative packaging the whole prior process as a sign-bearing referent
words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) packages the entire will-stilling-stagnation sequence into one demonstrative object. Its distance lets the reader step back from the vivid scene and judge it as evidence. Between the fronted preposition and the coming sign noun, the demonstrative is the hinge that turns a multi-clause process into a bounded referent for interpretation.

topics.headline: demonstrative gathers the prior process
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sign claim evaluates the whole chain, not merely the nearest noun.
topics.reason: The bundle resolves the demonstrative to the ship and wind scene, and the CRITICAL rows specify the whole sequence as its referent.

topics.headline: distal pointing creates interpretive distance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader steps back from the picture and treats it as a sign-bearing object.
topics.reason: The distal demonstrative is governed by the fronted preposition and bridges the event-domain into the sign assertion.

words.gloss_range: emphatic lām attached to the delayed sign noun, strengthening the final assertion
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) is emphatic, not a recipient preposition. Attached to the coming sign noun, it adds a second assertion layer after the earlier emphatic particle. The effect is argumentative: the stalled-scene interpretation is pressed as truly sign-bearing, not as an optional reflection on weather.

topics.headline: second assertion layer attached to signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final sign claim is reinforced twice and cannot be treated as incidental.
topics.reason: QAC identifies an emphatic marker, and the rows distinguish it from lexical or prepositional use while linking it with the emphatic clause.

words.gloss_range: indefinite plural sign noun delayed after the event-locus and marked by emphasis
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers signs, marks, proofs, and readable units; the local plural makes the maritime scene yield multiple evidentiary marks
words.prose: {{ar:ءَايَٰتٍۢ}} ({{tr:āyātin}}) is delayed until the listener has first held the whole event-domain. When it arrives, the indefinite plural says the one stalled-voyage scenario contains many signs, not one exhausted lesson. The root {{ar:أ ي ي}} ({{tr:ʾ-y-y}}) makes stopped motion readable as evidence, while a narrowed root-dispute pressure can make signs feel like points of return for orientation without replacing the local sign/proof sense. The surrounding emphasis and delay turn the scene into a deliberately framed object of interpretation; 42:32 and 42:33 together expand signhood from moving ships to immobilized ships. The kasra-tanwin cadence also links signs to the patient and grateful traits that can read them.

topics.headline: one scene opens into many asserted signs
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sign noun arrives late and plural, multiplying the evidentiary yield of the scene.
topics.reason: The word is the delayed governed noun of the emphatic clause, and its indefinite sound plural form supports multiple signs in one event.

topics.headline: stopped motion becomes readable evidence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the stalled voyage as a mark pointing beyond itself rather than opaque weather.
topics.reason: The sign-root rows connect mark, proof, and readable unit, while local co-occurrence gathers stillness and the reader traits.

topics.headline: possible return-orientation pressure near signhood
topics.reader_payoff: The reader may sense signs as things returned to for orientation, while the local noun remains signs and proofs.
topics.reason: The documented root dispute is meaningful as semantic pressure, but it cannot replace the locally selected sign noun.

topics.headline: neighboring sign cluster expands motion into suspension
topics.reader_payoff: The reader compares 42:32 moving ships as signs with 42:33 immobilized ships as signs.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete adjacent references and boundary movement from visible markers in 42:32 to explicit signs in 42:33.

topics.headline: sound thread links signs to recipient traits
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final clause bind evidence to the traits that can read it.
topics.reason: The tanwin observation is local and connects this sign plural with the closing reader traits.

words.gloss_range: recipient preposition routing the signs toward the qualified reader class
words.prose: {{ar:لِّ}} ({{tr:li}}) routes the asserted signs toward their readers. The preposition governs the following quantifier, so the event may be public, but its operative readability is marked for a qualified recipient. This shifts the clause from what the scene contains to who can benefit from and recognize it.

topics.headline: signs are marked for a qualified receiver
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final movement from evidence itself to the people for whom it becomes operative.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the following quantifier and marks beneficiary, recipient, or specialization in the sign claim.

topics.headline: public signs become readable through a moral-cognitive profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that eyesight alone is not the closing criterion; the signs are directed to a formed disposition.
topics.reason: The rows connect the proclitic form and the following qualified profile, narrowing operative reception without denying public evidence.

words.gloss_range: singular construct quantifier distributing sign-reception to every qualified individual
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers totality and comprehensive inclusion; the local construct distributes signs to every member of a qualified class
words.prose: {{ar:كُلِّ}} ({{tr:kulli}}) universalizes reception without making it casual. As a singular construct quantifier, it waits for the following traits to define the class, then distributes the signs to every member of that class one by one. The root {{ar:ك ل ل}} ({{tr:k-l-l}}) supplies totality, but the grammar bounds that totality inside the patient-grateful reader profile. Against 6:101, where totality covers created things, 42:33 shifts totality to qualified readers; the formula also resonates with 14:5, 31:31, and 34:19.

topics.headline: every is defined by the following traits
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that universality is real but grammatically bounded by the qualities that follow.
topics.reason: The word is genitive after the recipient preposition and heads a construct completed by the two adjectives.

topics.headline: plural signs become personally distributed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees public evidence become individually accountable for each qualified person.
topics.reason: The singular construct quantifier distributes across members of the qualified class rather than describing an undifferentiated crowd.

topics.headline: comprehensive language enters the sign-reader formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this every-qualified-reader claim with wider totality language and the recurring patient-grateful formula.
topics.reason: The rows give co-occurrence with signs, same-surah totality links, 6:101, and the phrase attested in 14:5, 31:31, and 34:19.

words.gloss_range: genitive intensive adjective defining the first trait of the sign-reader profile
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers patience, restraint, endurance, and pressure-bearing; the local intensive names repeated capacity under suspended motion
words.prose: {{ar:صَبَّارٍ}} ({{tr:ṣabbārin}}) gives the first trait that completes the recipient class. Its genitive intensive form makes patience part of who can read the signs, not a decorative moral afterthought. The root {{ar:ص ب ر}} ({{tr:ṣ-b-r}}) answers the stalled middle of the ayah: the reader able to endure repeated suspension can see stagnant ships as a sign rather than only as frustration. The formula links this maritime delay with wider sign-reading contexts such as 14:5, 31:31, and 34:19, and 42:43 later turns patience into an enacted response.

topics.headline: patience is grammatically inside the recipient class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that endurance defines the sign-reader rather than being optional commentary.
topics.reason: The adjective is genitive in the construct chain after the quantifier and begins the two-trait profile.

topics.headline: habitual endurance answers the immobilized scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the closing trait matched to the ships remaining motionless: delay requires trained endurance to become legible.
topics.reason: The intensive form and root field support repeated endurance, locally paired with the stagnation image.

topics.headline: patient-grateful formula enters windless sea scene
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a known sign-reader formula specialized to a stalled voyage, with 42:43 later verbalizing patience as response.
topics.reason: The rows supply formula references at 14:5, 31:31, and 34:19, plus a same-surah patience link at 42:43.

words.gloss_range: genitive intensive adjective completing the sign-reader profile with gratitude
words.root_gloss_range: root range covers gratitude, acknowledgment of benefit, and responsive thankfulness; the local intensive names settled recognition of provision
words.prose: {{ar:شَكُورٍ}} ({{tr:shakūrin}}) completes the reader profile and closes the ayah on gratitude. Its genitive intensive form remains inside the scope of the quantifier and pairs without a conjunction, so gratitude must accompany endurance for the signs to be fully readable. The root {{ar:ش ك ر}} ({{tr:sh-k-r}}) names recognition of benefit: when the wind is imagined withheld, ordinary propulsion appears as gift. As the final word, it leaves the stopped-wind scene resolved not in immobility but in settled grateful recognition, with 31:31 offering a sailing-sign parallel.

topics.headline: gratitude completes the compressed reader profile
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that gratitude is grammatically bound to patience as one recipient profile.
topics.reason: The adjective is genitive in the same chain and completes the paired profile without a conjunction.

topics.headline: withheld wind reveals propulsion as benefit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes ordinary movement as received provision once the ayah imagines the enabling wind removed.
topics.reason: The intensive form and gratitude root support settled acknowledgment of benefit, locally triggered by the wind-stilling scenario.

topics.headline: final word makes recognition the endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah end with the grateful reader rather than with stranded ships.
topics.reason: The rows connect the formula to 31:31 and other contexts, tie gratitude to wind and signs, and mark the final-word closure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُسْكِنِ ٱلرِّيحَ فَيَظْلَلْنَ رَوَاكِدَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهِ
baseline_models.mechanism: Causative stilling removes the vessels' moving medium; the continued state of يظللن and the after-motion fixity of رواكد hold them on the sea's exposed supporting surface. Ordinary mobility is disclosed as received rather than self-produced.

activation_trace.role: Loss of movement supplies the literal arrest and makes withdrawal of motion the mechanism.
Wind and moving air supply the otherwise unseen propulsive medium.
The branch's durative use of ظل makes the vessels continue in the imposed state rather than merely touch it.
Fixity after movement gives the vessels' resulting state and preserves the before-and-after contrast.
The raised outer surface supplies the visible support on which arrested motion can be inspected.

changed_reading.before: A calm wind leaves ships temporarily motionless.
changed_reading.after: The withdrawal of an unseen moving medium suspends an entire navigation system, exposing every visible journey as dependent motion.

baseline_models.mechanism: The stoppage does not decode itself. Patient self-restraint keeps attention present through delay, while gratitude recognizes and displays the benefit carried by a small event; together they turn interruption into plural signs.

activation_trace.role: A visible mark converts the physical state into something that can be read.
Holding the self against panic or impatience preserves observation during imposed delay.
Recognition and manifestation of benefit make the event answerable rather than merely endured.
A little input producing a visible effect supplies the perceptual amplification from one stoppage to many signs.

changed_reading.before: Patient and grateful people are praised after the maritime example.
changed_reading.after: Patience and gratitude are the paired reading capacities by which a delay becomes legible as a dense field of signs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding ayah first presents vessels flowing on vast water like conspicuous markers; the focus then reverses flow into fixity and again names signs. The sign is sharpened by the transition between motion and arrest, not by either state alone.

activation_trace.role: Flowing movement supplies the normal state that the focus ayah reverses.
Vast abundant water supplies the medium across which the moving and stopped states remain visibly comparable.
A distinguishing visible mark makes the large vessels perceptual reference points before their arrest.
The first sign formula marks the vessels in motion as readable.
Stilling supplies the decisive reversal from ordinary flow.
The repeated sign formula identifies the altered state as a second readable presentation.

structural_cues: 42:32 and 42:33 are adjacent and move from الجوار في البحر to رواكد.
The sign formula occurs before the moving vessel and again after its arrest.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies flow, conspicuous vessels, sudden stilling, and repeated signs; I supply the arrow that contrast makes dependence legible. A live alternative is that motion and stillness are simply two independent signs.

changed_reading.before: The ships' impressive movement is the maritime sign, and calm is an added warning.
changed_reading.after: The sign is reversible mobility itself: the same visible masses flow and then become fixed when their enabling medium is withheld.

context_deltas.mechanism: The maritime unit is bracketed by failure to outrun power on earth and failure to find an evasive outlet. Arrested vessels materially stage that bounded agency: impressive mobility remains movement within a field it cannot escape.

activation_trace.role: Failure to get away from pursuit supplies the pre-scene limit on human mobility.
Loss of motion turns the abstract inability to escape into an inspectable physical state.
Fixity after movement shows that prior range never amounted to autonomous escape.
Turning aside from a direction supplies the denied evasive outlet after the vessel scene.

structural_cues: 42:31 precedes the ship sequence with وما أنتم بمعجزين.
42:35 closes it with ما لهم من محيص.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two denials of evasion around the arrested ships; I infer that the ship is a material demonstration of bounded agency. The alternative is that the framing clauses concern punishment only and do not redescribe navigation.

changed_reading.before: The verse demonstrates dependence on weather.
changed_reading.after: It demonstrates that even far-ranging mobility cannot become evasion: the traveler remains arrestable within the very medium of travel.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, provision is spread or narrowed, and immediately before the ship scene it is sent down by measure according to will because unbounded expansion would produce transgression; relief then arrives after despair. The same will that stops wind can therefore be read as calibrated restraint within a larger rhythm of release and relief.

activation_trace.role: Spreading and extension supply one pole of controlled provision.
Constriction to a limited measure supplies the opposite pole.
Unrestricted extension is explicitly linked to a harmful social consequence.
Measured arrangement supplies deliberate modulation rather than accidental scarcity.
Will links measured descent directly to the focus ayah's conditional stilling.
Relief of the distressed supplies the release that can follow a period of restraint.
The conditional will places wind-stilling inside the same modulation pattern.
Cessation becomes the restricted phase of the release-restraint rhythm.

structural_cues: يبسط and يقدر are paired in 42:12.
42:27-28 move from measured descent to relief, directly before 42:29-33.
يشاء recurs across the provision, gathering, and vessel passages.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured expansion, restraint, will, and subsequent relief; I infer that stopped wind may be calibrated restraint rather than pure deprivation. The live alternative is that no merciful purpose is assigned to this particular stoppage.

changed_reading.before: The stopped wind is an arbitrary deprivation used to test travelers.
changed_reading.after: The stopped wind can be a measured withholding within a governance pattern that limits, releases, and relieves rather than maximizing motion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus ayah stands between a repeated earned-consequence-and-pardon formula and the explicit alternative of destroying the vessels. Mere arrest becomes a preserved middle state: exposed, unable to proceed, yet not made to perish.

activation_trace.role: An affliction that befalls a person establishes the consequence pattern before the ships.
Acquired action supplies responsibility for what befalls.
Leaving punishment and effacing fault establishes pardon alongside consequence.
The vessels' fixity supplies a nonfatal but fully exposed intermediate condition.
Destruction supplies the harsher adjacent alternative against which stillness becomes reprieve.
Earned action repeats the responsibility link specifically for the vessels.
Repeated pardon keeps non-destruction active within the same consequence structure.

structural_cues: 42:30 and 42:34 repeat earning and pardoning around the maritime passage.
أو يوبقهن in 42:34 presents destruction as an alternative immediately after stationary survival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies earned affliction, pardon, stillness, and possible vessel destruction; I infer that stationary survival is a reprieve between travel and ruin. The alternative is that stilling and destruction are parallel threats with no positive value assigned to the first.

changed_reading.before: Stationary ships depict delay or helplessness.
changed_reading.after: Stationary ships occupy a morally charged reprieve: motion has been withheld, but destruction has also been withheld.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, one acquired good is increased and the divine response is named شكور. The focus applies the same intensive adjective to the sign-reader, while its branch image describes little input yielding a visible increase. Gratitude becomes an amplifying mode of perception: one altered condition unfolds into many signs.

activation_trace.role: Growth and increase supply the earlier transformation of one good into more good.
A little input with a manifest enlarging effect links appreciative response to amplification.
Plural visible marks are the enlarged perceptual yield.
The grateful reader makes a single cessation cognitively fruitful.

structural_cues: شكور occurs in 42:23 after explicit increase and returns as the sign-reader's quality in 42:33.
A singular demonstrative event in 42:33 yields plural آيات.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies increase, the repeated intensive شكور, and the small-input/visible-effect branch; I infer an epistemic amplification from one event to many signs. The alternative is that شكور remains only a general moral commendation.

changed_reading.before: Gratitude is the proper response after recognizing the sign.
changed_reading.after: Gratitude helps produce the recognition: it magnifies a small interruption into multiple relations of dependence, restraint, and preservation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later ethical sequence permits resistance to wrong yet repeatedly values forgiveness, reconciliation, and deliberate patience. Because the focus wind can branch as force or dominance, its stilling becomes a material analogue for arresting retaliatory momentum without confusing restraint with inability.

activation_trace.role: Wind as force and dominance supplies the power whose motion can be deliberately arrested.
Stilling supplies the physical pattern of de-escalation.
Surging anger supplies the human reactive force.
Shielding the offender from the effect of fault supplies the first arrest of retaliation.
Leaving punishment supplies chosen non-escalation after equivalent response remains available.
Removing estrangement gives restrained force a reparative direction.
Holding the self against reaction returns the focus adjective as an enacted social practice.
Firmly resolved intention prevents patience and pardon from being read as mere powerlessness.

structural_cues: 42:37-43 distinguishes retaliation, pardon, reconciliation, patience, and resolved intention.
The focus صبار returns as the finite صبر in 42:43.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies force, anger, legitimate resistance, pardon, and resolved patience; I supply the analogy between meteorological arrest and ethical de-escalation. The alternative is that the two domains are adjacent exhortations without a shared mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The patient person passively tolerates being stalled.
changed_reading.after: The patient person mirrors controlled stilling by arresting retaliatory force while retaining the capacity to act and redirecting it toward repair.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah closes by describing communication through hidden imparting, from behind a barrier, or through a messenger, then names revelation روحا and light that guides. The focus's ريح shares the life-breath root and is an unseen carrier known by its visible effects. Its withdrawal makes dependence on an imperceptible conveying current readable at the surface.

activation_trace.role: Hidden imparting supplies transmission whose source is not directly visible in its receiver.
A screening barrier sharpens the distinction between concealed agency and manifest effect.
Spirit as the life of a body activates an enlivening branch of the focus wind's root.
Illumination supplies the visible efficacy of what was conveyed.
Gentle direction toward a path supplies purposeful movement produced by the conveyed light.
Literal wind supplies an invisible current whose presence is inferred from movement.
The life-breath branch makes withdrawal of wind available as an animation analogy while remaining anchored to ريح.
Visible outward appearance supplies the surface on which hidden causation becomes manifest.

structural_cues: The surah opens with repeated revelation language and closes with its modes in 42:51-52.
ريح in 42:33 and روحا in 42:52 share the packet root ر و ح.
The visible surface term ظهر in the focus contrasts with hidden imparting and حجاب near the close.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a shared root, hidden modes of conveyance, life-spirit, light, guidance, and visible wind effects; I infer a common unseen-carrier mechanism. The live alternative is that the shared root merely juxtaposes distinct lexical branches with no intended analogy.

changed_reading.before: The verse offers a meteorological proof of control.
changed_reading.after: It can also materialize how unseen conveyance animates passage: when the carrier is withdrawn, visible vehicles stop, making the hidden enabling current perceptible by absence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it imports the scale into a maritime scene through a form-distant ركود branch and the ship-specific سكان branch. It remains anchored because رواكد explicitly carries a scale settling after oscillation and يسكن carries a vessel-stabilizing member, while 42:17 supplies the balance; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy, not as the lexical meaning of the clause.

activation_trace.role: The ship's steering or stabilizing member makes controlled arrest mechanically native to the vessel domain.
A balance settling after oscillation supplies exact equilibrium as the quality of rest.
The balance of justice gives the settled-scale image a live whole-surah analogue.

changed_reading.before: The ships are simply deprived of speed.
changed_reading.after: The ships can resemble a balance whose motion has settled: rest is exact equilibrium, and that measured steadiness is itself the sign.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps a ship onto a body and wind onto animating breath. It remains valid as an exploratory activation because the focus wind's own root contains life-spirit, 42:52 realizes that branch as روحا, and the vessel visibly passes from motion to inertness; downstream prose should say death-like or body-like suspension and must not claim that ريح lexically means soul here.

activation_trace.role: Life-spirit activates the analogy of wind as what animates an otherwise inert carrier.
Fixity after movement supplies the body's death-like loss of animation.
Loss of force and life supplies the surah's explicit contrast state for animation.
The later occurrence realizes the shared root as spirit, keeping the body analogy packet-internal.

changed_reading.before: A vessel stops when its external fuel disappears.
changed_reading.after: The vessel can be seen as a body held in reversible, death-like suspension when its animating breath is withdrawn.

strongest_changes: The adjacent shift from flowing vessels to stationary vessels makes reversible mobility, rather than grandeur alone, the sign.
The no-escape frame in 42:31 and 42:35 turns arrested navigation into a demonstration of bounded agency.
The earned-consequence and pardon pattern in 42:30 and 42:34 makes stillness a reprieve between continued travel and destruction.
The recurrence of شكور with increase makes gratitude an amplifying way of perceiving many signs in one interruption.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet joined a tight local maritime mechanism to distant but exact lexical returns: measured expansion and restraint, active patience and pardon, شكور as increase from little, and ريح/روح as an unseen enabling current. These activations preserve warning, mercy, ethics, and communication as distinct readings rather than forcing one synthesis.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet sustains both threat and merciful restraint; it does not force one value for the stopped wind.
The ريح/روح bridge is mechanically coherent but remains exploratory because shared root and hidden motion do not prove a deliberate body or revelation metaphor.
The settled-scale and ship-stabilizer branches are unusually apt material analogies but are form-distant enough to require explicit qualification.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Stopping the unseen mover turns monumental travel into surface-bound stillness.** Lexical evidence: س ك ن `B001` (cessation of motion), ر و ح `B003` (wind/moving air), ر ك د `B001` (stillness), and ظ ه ر `B003` (upper surface). Structural cue and role: wind is stilled first; ships consequently remain motionless on the sea's back. Abductive move: the packet supplies the causal arrow; I infer that the contrast reveals dependence of visible mass on invisible motion. Reading change: the ships are signs not of autonomous power but of enabled movement.

2. **The stalled voyage requires restrained endurance that still recognizes benefit.** Lexical evidence: ص ب ر `B001` (self-restraint from panic) and ش ك ر `B001` (recognizing favor). Structural cue and role: the double intensive qualities identify the reader able to discern multiple signs in delay. Abductive move: I infer that patience keeps interruption from becoming panic, while gratitude remembers the wind as gift. Reading change: sign-recognition is a practiced response to both motion and stoppage.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 42:43 later joins patience to forgiveness and calls both resolute. That ethical sequence made **صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ** here preparation for handling not only delay but injury without losing agency.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Stopping wind exposes hidden power behind visible motion.** **Lexical evidence:** س ك ن `B001` (cessation of motion), ر و ح `B003` (wind and moving air) with `B011` (power, force, and dominance), and ر ك د `B001` (stillness and remaining at rest). **Structural cue:** 42:32 presents sailing ships as signs; the fixed ayah removes wind and leaves them fixed on the sea's back; 42:34 can then destroy them. **Assigned role:** wind is the unseen carrier of force, and stillness reveals that the ships' visible motion was derivative. **Abductive move:** I infer power from the accepted wind branch and the counterfactual removal of motion. **Reading change:** calming the wind is not only a weather event but an analytical disclosure of where agency was located.
2. **The sign requires an ethic capable of reading both deprivation and gift.** **Lexical evidence:** ص ب ر `B001` (self-restraint from panic) and ش ك ر `B002` (thriving visibly on little provision), anchored in صَبَّارٍ شَكُورٍ. **Structural cue:** the ship may be deprived of motion; 42:36 calls received things temporary benefit; 42:37 restrains anger; 42:38 spends provision. **Assigned role:** patience sustains interpretation during arrested motion, and thanks converts limited provision into visible good. **Abductive move:** I infer that the paired dispositions are reading capacities, not unrelated virtues appended to a nautical sign. **Reading change:** the sign becomes legible through disciplined response to alternating constraint and enablement.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 42:34-35 showed the destructive and no-escape side of arrested motion, while 42:36-38 moved through temporary use, restraint, counsel, and expenditure. Those later ayat confirmed صبر and شكر as capacities for turning alternating constraint and provision into ethical action.

baseline.text: O dilerse rüzgârı durdurur ve gemiler denizin üzerinde hareketsiz kalır. Bunda çok sabreden ve çok şükreden herkes için işaretler vardır.

findings.text: Görünmeyen rüzgârın kesilmesi, gemilerin görünen hareketinin kendi güçlerinden değil, onları taşıyan dış kuvvetten geldiğini açığa çıkarır.
Sabır ve şükür, hem hareketin durmasını hem yeniden sağlanan imkânı okuyabilen iki algı disiplini olarak birlikte çalışır.

inter_ayah_rows.note: The storming wind sent against 'Ad gives another direct instance of wind as a divinely deployed force.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: A frost-bearing wind that destroys crops supplies a limited image of wind changing the value of human effort.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Seeking help through patience and prayer provides a central ethical articulation of the patience named in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Patient endurance through fear, loss, and hardship gives substantive trial-context to the focus's patient audience.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Prophets and their followers neither weakened nor yielded under hardship, giving a robust communal form of patience.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The command to persevere and remain steadfast reinforces patience as an active, sustained discipline.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Patience is required to preserve strength and avoid failure, clarifying its practical role under changing conditions.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Jacob's beautiful patience in loss gives a strong human example of the focus's patient response.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Jacob again turns to beautiful patience while awaiting an outcome beyond his control.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: God's preservation of the reward for the mindful and patient supplies an explicit positive valuation of patience.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The promise that gratitude brings increase directly clarifies why gratitude is the appropriate response to preserved or renewed provision.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The enduring reward for those who are patient gives a direct consequence to the disposition named in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The patient are promised reward without measure, strongly valuing the focus's required response though outside its maritime setting.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: A demanding good response is granted only to those who are patient, presenting patience as a disciplined capacity.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The messenger is commanded to be patient like the resolute messengers, providing a high-level prophetic model of steadfastness.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The command to remember God and thank Him gives a direct general articulation of the focus's grateful response.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Enjoyment of good provision is explicitly paired with gratitude to God, linking bounty to the response named in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: God rewards the grateful, giving gratitude an explicit moral and consequential force.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: God's non-punishment of grateful believers directly contrasts gratitude with the refusal to recognize divine favor.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Eating lawful provision is joined to gratitude to God, reinforcing gratitude as the proper acknowledgment of sustenance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Created hearing, sight, and hearts are presented as gifts for which people are insufficiently grateful, a broad sign-and-gratitude parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The alternation of night and day is made for whoever wishes to remember or be grateful, closely pairing changing conditions with gratitude.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Solomon asks to be enabled to give thanks for divine favor, providing an explicit model of responsive gratitude.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Wisdom is framed as gratitude to God, linking grateful recognition to rightly reading divine gifts.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: A land's provision is followed by the command to eat, thank the Lord, and recognize His forgiving care.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: God is pleased with gratitude from His servants, directly affirming the response required by the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Humans are shown the way and divided between gratitude and ingratitude, making gratitude a decisive response to guidance.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Vessel Underway
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Wind drives a loaded vessel across a broad surface while visible markers orient its passage.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: broad abundant water `quranic:root_000086:B001/m01`; flowing current or sailing `quranic:root_000240:B001/m01`; propelling wind `quranic:root_000609:B003/m01`; back or supporting surface `quranic:root_000970:B002/m01`; load-bearing mount `quranic:root_000970:B005/m01`; marker, flag, or landmark `quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The vessel rides the sea as a burden rides a back: current and wind supply movement, the surface bears the load, and markers make the transit intelligible. Propulsion and orientation are jointly necessary.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Arrested Motion and Entrapment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Motion is stopped; steering becomes stabilization, then stillness hardens into being stuck and exposed to destruction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: stopping movement `quranic:root_000726:B001/m01`; rudder or stabilizing device `quranic:root_000726:B008/m01`; stagnation after motion `quranic:root_000590:B001/m01`; destruction `quranic:root_001618:B002/m01`; being trapped until destruction `quranic:root_001618:B003/m01`.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Stillness has two possible functions: a rudder can restrain motion to preserve control, but imposed calm can immobilize the whole vessel. Once arrest becomes entrapment, the medium of travel becomes the place of destruction.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, önceki hareketin ya da çalkantının sona ermesini ve şeyin ardından durup dengelenmesini açıkça temel anlam olarak verir. Susma ile rüzgar, yağmur ve öfkenin dinmesi bu çekirdeğin bağlama bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yerleşme, ev halkı, yoksulluk ya da araç adlarını değil, hareketten sonra durma ve dinginleşmeyi anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın durma çekirdeğini korur; rüzgar, yağmur ve öfke kullanımlarını yalnızca belirli bağlamlara bağlı uzantılar olarak ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin hareketi veya çalkantısı sona ererek durması, yerinde kalması ya da dinginleşmesidir. Susma ile rüzgarın, yağmurun ve öfkenin dinmesi bu değişimin belirli bağlamlardaki görünüşleridir.

facets.statement: Önceden hareket eden veya çalkalanan şeyin hareketi sona erer.
Hareketin bitmesiyle şey durur, yerinde kalır veya dingin bir duruma geçer.
Susma ile rüzgarın, yağmurun ve öfkenin dinmesi aynı değişimin bağlama bağlı kullanımlarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çizgisi, hareket veya çalkantıdan sonra gelen durma, yerinde kalma ve dinginleşmedir; sessizlik ve doğa olaylarının ya da öfkenin yatışması da bu çizgide ele alınır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Önceki hareketin veya çalkantının sona erip ardından durma ve dinginlik oluştuğu genel çekirdeği karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Hareketin bitmesini ve bunun sonucunda durma ya da dinginleşme oluşmasını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Rüzgar, yağmur veya öfke gibi hareketli ya da şiddetli bir durumun yatıştığı bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli bir hareket veya şiddet durumunun sona ererek yatışmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Çalkantıdan sonra dengeli ve dingin duruma geçişin öne çıktığı anlatımlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Çalkantının bitmesini ve ardından dengeli bir durum oluşmasını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: hareketi veya çalkantısı dindi ve durdu
rüzgar, yağmur ya da öfke dindi

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da hareket veya çalkantıdan sonra durmayı, yerinde kalmayı ve dinginleşmeyi aynı çekirdekte toplar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu karttaki su, rüzgar, gemi ve topluluk örnekleri sınırı değiştirmez; bunlar aynı durma ve dinginleşme çekirdeğinin örnekleridir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, önceki hareketin veya çalkantının sona ermesini gerekli başlangıç noktası yapar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yumuşaklık, kolaylık ve sertlikten uzak davranış biçimini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de çalkantısız, dingin ve zorlamasız bir durumu anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bir durum değişimini, komşu dal ise bunun yanında yumuşak ve kaygısız oluş biçimini anlatır; bu yüzden her bağlamda birbirlerinin yerine geçmezler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal hareketin ve çalkantının biterek durulmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal güçlü sarsıntı ve yoğun çalkantının sürmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir şeyin hareket ve denge durumunu aynı eksende değerlendirir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta hareket sona erip denge oluşurken komşuda güçlü hareket ve dengesizlik belirginleşir; ortak eksende ters yönleri gösterirler.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Verilen bütün komşu kartları değerlendirildi. En keskin eşdeğerlik, yakınlık ve karşıtlık bu üçünde bulundu; öteki kartlar ayrı kök dallarına, özel araçlara veya uzak bağlamlara aittir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü bir yerde yerleşip yaşamayı, yaşanan yeri, birini orada oturtmayı ve bir evi karşılıksız kullanıma bırakmayı birlikte bildirir. Dal çerçevesi bunları yerleşme ve konut ekseninde doğru biçimde toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Burada odak, yerleşme eylemi ve yaşanan yerdir; orada yaşayan kişiler ya da iç dinginlik bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın yerleşip yaşama anlamını temel alır; konut, birini oturtma ve karşılıksız kullanım verme biçimlerini aynı söz ailesinin açık uzantıları olarak gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yere yerleşip orada yaşama ve o yeri yaşanan yer edinmedir. Aynı alan, yaşanan yerin kendisini, birini oraya yerleştirmeyi ve bir evi kira almadan kullanımına vermeyi de kapsar.

facets.statement: Kişi bir yere yerleşir ve orada yaşamını sürdürür.
Yerleşilip yaşanan ev veya yer, bu eylemin yer adı olarak anlatılır.
Birini bir yerde oturtma ve evi kira almadan kullanımına verme de bu alanın ettirgen ve hukuki uzantılarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yerleşip yaşama eylemini, yaşanan ev veya yeri, bir başkasını oraya yerleştirmeyi ve bir evi kira karşılığı olmadan kullanımına bırakmayı aynı anlam alanında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın yalın eylem çekirdeğini, yani bir yeri sürekli veya yerleşik biçimde yaşanan yer edinmeyi karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Bir yere yerleşme ile orada yaşamayı tek süreç içinde korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eylemden çok kişinin yerleşip yaşadığı evin veya yerin kendisi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yerleşilip yaşanan yer olma niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin başka birini belirli bir evde veya yerde oturur duruma getirdiği ettirgen bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Başkasını bir yerde oturur ve yaşar duruma getirme işlemini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir evi kira almadan oturması için verme
onu bir evde veya yerde oturttu
konut olarak kullanılan ev veya yer

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yerleşip yaşama eylemini, birini yerleştirmeyi ve karşılıksız kullanım vermeyi de içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal geceleme ve sığınma yerlerini, çadırı ve saray gibi farklı barınak adlarını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da insanın yaşadığı evi veya barındığı yeri gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yaşama yerini yerleşme eylemiyle birlikte kurar; komşu dalın çekirdeği ise gecelemeye veya barınmaya yarayan yerin kendisidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal yerleşik yaşamı, konutu ve bir başkasını orada oturtmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal insan veya hayvan için konak yeri seçme, hazırlama ve elverişli ya da elverişsiz çevre niteliğini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir yeri kalınacak veya yaşanacak yer olarak edinme vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta yerleşip yaşama ve konutlaşma belirgindir; komşuda yer seçme ve hazırlama işlemi ile hayvan barınağına uzanan daha geniş bir alan vardır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal genel yerleşme eylemini ve yaşanan yeri anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kalıplaşmış çoğul kullanımlarda konumları, düzeyleri veya alışılmış düzeni ve ayrıca bedensel bir yerleşme noktasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir varlığın bulunduğu veya yerleştiği yeri gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak gündelik yerleşme ve konut alanıdır; komşu ise belirli kalıplara, özel bir yer adına ve başın boyundaki oturma noktasına bağlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı. Seçilen üç komşu yerleşme, barınak ve sabit konum sınırlarını doğrudan aydınlatır; kalanlar dönemlik kalış, çadır, eşya veya uzak kök dallarıyla sınırlıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü evde yaşayanları, ev halkını ve bakmakla yükümlü olunan aile üyelerini açıkça dalın gönderimi yapar. Çerçeve, evi ya da yerleşme eylemini değil o yerde yaşayan insan topluluğunu doğru biçimde ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, evin kendisini değil evde yaşayanları ve ev halkını anlatır; genel akrabalık veya her tür topluluk bağı daha geniştir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ev halkını yalın çekirdek olarak verir; çoğul sakinler ve evde yaşayanları belirten kalıp kullanımı bu çekirdeğin ayrı gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_map.definition: Bir evde yaşayan kişiler, özellikle aynı evin halkı ve aile yükümlülüğü içinde bulunan kimselerdir. Daha genel çoğul kullanım, belirli bir yerde oturanların tümünü gösterebilir.

facets.statement: Gönderim, evin kendisine değil o evde yaşayan kişilere yönelir.
Aynı evin halkı ve bakmakla yükümlü olunan aile üyeleri bu grubun belirgin özel alanıdır.
Çoğul kullanım, bir evde veya başka bir yerde oturanların tümüne genişleyebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı, sözü ev halkı, aile üyeleri ve evde ya da belirli bir yerde oturan kişiler için kullanır; fiziksel ev ile içindeki topluluk açıkça ayrılır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Evde yaşayan topluluğu hem aile halkı hem de daha genel oturanlar yönüyle karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Evin içindeki kişileri, aile halkı ile genel oturanlar kapsamını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Aynı evde yaşayan aile ve bakmakla yükümlü olunan kişiler özellikle kastedildiğinde doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Aynı evde yaşayan aile topluluğunu ve yakın ev bağını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Aile bağı aranmadan belirli bir evde veya yerde oturanların tümü kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli yerde oturan kişiler topluluğunu aile bağı eklemeden korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal evde oturanların tümüne uzanabilir ve aile bağını her kullanımda zorunlu tutmaz.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal aileye bağlanan kişileri ve kadın ya da topluluk için aktarmalı ev kullanımını da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da aynı eve bağlı aile halkını ve birlikte yaşayan kişileri gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta belirleyici bağ fiilen evde yaşamaktır; komşuda aileye veya eve bağlanma, gerçek oturma bulunmadan da gönderimi kurabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal belirli evde yaşayan kişilerle sınırlı bir topluluk kurar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal eş, yakınlar, soy, din, iş ve ülke gibi çok farklı üyelik bağlarını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal aynı evde yaşayan yakın kişiler topluluğunu anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak için ortak yaşama yeri merkezdir; komşuda ortak ev yalnızca üyeliği kurabilen bağlardan biridir ve kapsam çok daha geniştir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal evde yaşayan insan topluluğunu gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yerleşme eylemini, yaşanan evi ve birini oraya yerleştirmeyi gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal aynı ev ve orada yaşama durumunun katılımcılarını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Biri yaşayan kişilere, diğeri yaşama eylemine ve fiziksel yere yönelir; gönderimleri farklı olduğu için birbirlerinin yerine kullanılamaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm komşular değerlendirildi. Seçilenler ev halkı, daha geniş bağlı topluluk ve fiziksel konut arasındaki temel karışmaları gösterir; diğer adaylar tek kişi, eşlik veya uzak yan dallardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü kişinin içinin yöneldiği ve yanında dinginleştiği sevgiliyi ya da şeyi temel alır; gece, yakarış ve ateş bunun örnekleridir. Dal çerçevesi bu rahatlatıcı ve yakınlık veren dayanağı doğru yakalar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Odak iç dinginliği sağlayan kişi veya şeydir; yalnız fiziksel durma, ağırbaşlı iç durum ya da salt sıcaklık değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın olarak kişinin yanında rahatlayıp dinginleştiği dayanağı verir; gece, yakarış ve ateş kullanımları ile ateşle düzeltme ayrı bağlamlara bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin yakınlık duyup yanında rahatladığı, içinin yatıştığı kişi veya şeydir. Gece, destekleyici yakarış ve yanında oturulan ateş bu rahatlatıcı işlevle adlandırılabilir.

facets.statement: Kişi sevdiği veya yakın bulduğu birine ya da şeye yönelir ve onun yanında içi yatışır.
Gece ve destekleyici yakarış, dinlenme veya güven verme işlevleriyle aynı adlandırma alanına girer.
Yanında oturulup yakınlık ve rahatlık bulunan ateş bu anlamın somut bir gerçekleşmesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kişinin sevdiği veya yakın bulduğu şeyin yanında içinin yatışmasını ortak çekirdek yapar; geceyi, destekleyici yakarışı ve ateşi bu rahatlatıcı işlevin örnekleri olarak verir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişi, zaman, sözlü destek veya ateşin insana yakınlık ve iç rahatlığı vermesi ortak çekirdeğini karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Rahatlatan dayanağı ve insanın ona yönelerek içinin yatışmasını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sevilen kişi ya da destekleyici söz gibi bir dayanağın ruhsal rahatlık sağladığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin bir dayanağa yönelmesini ve onunla iç rahatlığı bulmasını korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü ağırbaşlılık, yumuşak başlılık, güven ve kalbin yatışmasını aynı iç durum çevresinde birleştirir. Sandık içindeki şeyin insanlara güven verip kaçmalarını önlemesi bu çekirdeğin özel anlatısıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal dış hareketin yalnızca durmasını değil, güvenle birleşen ağırbaşlı ve dingin iç durumu anlatır; yoksulluk ve ezilmişlik ayrı kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ağırbaşlı iç dinginliği yalın çekirdek yapar; kalbe verilmesi ve sandıktaki güven verici şey yalnız kendi kalıpları içinde tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Korku ve taşkınlığın yerini güvenin, ağırbaşlılığın ve yumuşak bir iç dinginliğinin almasıdır. Kalbe verilen güven ile topluluğu bir arada tutan sandık içeriği bu durumun özel anlatımlarıdır.

facets.statement: İç dünyada güven, dinginlik ve ağırbaşlılık birlikte belirir.
Kalbin korkudan kurtulup güven duyması bu iç durumun belirgin gerçekleşmesidir.
Bir sandığın içindeki güven verici şey, insanların kalplerini yatıştırıp onları bir arada tutması bakımından adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ağırbaşlılık, yumuşak başlılık, güven ve kalp dinginliğini ortak bir iç durum olarak sunar; kalbe güven verilmesi ve sandıktaki güven verici şey bunun özel anlatılarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Güven, kalp yatışması, yumuşak başlılık ve ağırbaşlılığın birlikte bulunduğu tam çekirdeği karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: İç dinginliği güven ve ağırbaşlılıkla birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Korku veya tedirginlik içindeki kişinin kalben güvenli ve dingin duruma getirildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kalpteki korkunun yerini güven ve dinginliğin almasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sandıktaki şeyin topluluğa güven verip dağılmasını önleyen işlevi açıklandığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Somut bir dayanağın kalpleri yatıştırıp güven oluşturma işlevini korur.

inananların kalplerine güven ve dinginlik verdi

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da çalkantının azalması ve dingin bir son durum bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak insanın iç dünyasında güven ve ağırbaşlılık içerir; komşu için iç dünya ve güven gerekli değildir, hareketin sona ermesi yeterlidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kişinin içinde oluşan güvenli, ağırbaşlı ve dingin durumu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kişiyi rahatlatan ve kendisine yönelinen kişi, zaman, söz veya ateşi adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak oluşan iç durumdur; komşu ise çoğunlukla bu durumu doğuran veya yanında bulunan dayanağa yönelir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal güvenli, ağırbaşlı ve dengeli bir iç durumu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yoksulluk, güçsüzlük, ezilmişlik ve boyun eğme durumlarını bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da dış taşkınlığın bulunmadığı, alçak sesli veya çekingen bir görünüşle ilişkilendirilebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odakta güven ve dengeli ağırbaşlılık vardır; komşuda yoksunluk, güçsüzlük ya da baskı altında boyun eğme vardır, bu nedenle değer ve neden bakımından ayrılırlar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Verilen bütün komşular gözden geçirildi. Dış durma, rahatlatıcı dayanak ve ezilmişlik ile olan üç sınır en yararlı karşılaştırmaları verir; dış adaylar bu anlamla yeterli ortak çekirdek taşımaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü yoksulluk halini, güçsüzlük ve ezilmişliği, ayrıca kişinin boyun eğip kendini aşağı koymasını aynı dalda açıkça sayar. Dal çerçevesi maddi yoksunluk ile toplumsal veya iradi boyun eğme arasındaki bağı korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal hem yoksulluğu hem ezilmiş ve güçsüz durumu kapsar; ağırbaşlı iç dinginlik ya da evde yaşama anlamları buna dahil değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın tek anlam varsaymaz; yoksul kişi ve yoksulluk durumunu, ezilmişlik ile boyun eğme bildiren türemiş eylemlerden açıkça ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Geçim araçlarından yoksun olma veya güçsüz, ezilmiş ve aşağı durumda bulunmadır. Bu durumdan hareketle kişinin boyun eğmesi ya da kendini aşağı koyması da aynı söz ailesinde anlatılır.

facets.statement: Kişi geçim araçlarından yoksun ve yardıma gerek duyan durumda olabilir.
Söz, maddi yoksunluktan bağımsız olarak güçsüzlük, ezilmişlik ve aşağı durumda bulunmayı da anlatabilir.
Kişinin boyun eğmesi, kendini aşağı koyması veya yoksul duruma gelmesi türemiş eylemlerle ifade edilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çerçevesi yoksul kişiyi ve yoksulluk durumunu güçsüzlük, ezilmişlik ve boyun eğmeyle ilişkilendirir; türemiş eylemler kişinin yoksullaşmasını veya kendini aşağı koymasını anlatır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Maddi yoksunluk ile aşağı ve güçsüz durumda bulunma yönlerini birlikte taşıyan dalın tam alanını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yoksulluğu, güçsüzlüğü ve ezilmişliği birbirine indirgemeden birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin geçim araçlarından yoksun oluşu ile zayıf toplumsal durumunun birlikte kastedildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin hem maddi yoksunluğunu hem güçsüz durumunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin baskı veya bağlılık karşısında kendini güçsüz ve aşağı konuma koyduğu eylem bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Boyun eğme ile kendini aşağı konuma koyma eylemini birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü kesici bıçağı doğrudan adlandırır ve adlandırmayı kesilen hayvanın hareketini ölümle sona erdirmesine bağlar. Dal çerçevesi aracı ve verilen köken açıklamasını koruyarak gemi parçasından ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kesici bıçak ile onu yapan kişiyi kapsar; gemi dengeleme parçası ya da kesme eyleminin kendisi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım bıçak adını yalın araç anlamıyla verir; hayvanın hareketini sona erdirmeye dayalı ad açıklamasını çekirdeğin yerine geçirmeyen bağlı bir açıklama olarak tutar.

concept_map.definition: Kesmekte kullanılan ağızlı bıçaktır. Kaynaklar adını, kesilen hayvanın hareketini ölümle sona erdirmesi üzerinden açıklar; aracı yapan kişi de ayrı bir türemiş adla gösterilir.

facets.statement: Gönderim, kesmekte kullanılan ağızlı bıçaktır.
Adın kökeni, bıçağın kesilen hayvanın hareketini ölümle sona erdirmesine bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kesici bıçağın bilinen araç olduğunu ortaklaşa belirtir ve adlandırılmasını, kesilen hayvanın hareketini sona erdirme sonucuyla açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın araç gönderimini kısa ve doğal biçimde karşılar; adın köken açıklaması tanımda ayrıca korunur.

error_profile.preserves: Kesici aracı ve hayvan kesme bağlamındaki işlevini birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal belirli bir bıçak adını ve hayvanın hareketini sona erdirmeye bağlanan ad açıklamasını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kesme araçlarını, kılıcı, kısa geniş ağzı ve kesik oku kapsayan daha geniş bir araç ve ağız alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal keskin ağızla kesme işlevi gören elde kullanılan araçları kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak belirli bıçak türünün genel adıdır; komşu farklı kesici araçları ve keskin ağız biçimlerini daha geniş bir kümede toplar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal bütün kesici bıçağın kendisini gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kılıç veya bıçağın keskin kenarını ve herhangi bir şeyin kesici ucunu gösterir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak araç bütünüdür, komşu ise aracın kesen kenarı veya ucudur; parça ile bütün aynı gönderime sahip değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal kesme aracını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal hayvanın boyun kemiğini kesme işlemini adlandırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü geminin kıçındaki, onu dengede tutup çalkantısını azaltan bölüm veya aracı açıkça verir. Dal çerçevesi bu gemiye özgü gönderimi ve dengeleme işlevini kesici bıçak anlamından doğru biçimde ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnız geminin kıçındaki dengeleyici ve yöneltici bölüm ya da araçla ilgilidir; geminin tamamını veya genel durma eylemini adlandırmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım gemi parçasının özel adını yalın biçimde korur; gemiyle kurulan kalıp ifade aynı parçayı işleviyle belirleyen kullanımdır ve genel durma anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Geminin kıçında bulunan, gemiyi dengede tutmaya, yöneltmeye ve çalkantısını azaltmaya yarayan bölüm veya araçtır. Adlandırma doğrudan bu dengeleme işlevine bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Gönderim geminin kıçında bulunan belirli bir bölüm veya araçtır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Parçanın gemideki yerini ve gemiyi dengeleyip yöneltme işlevini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kıçtaki araç olmayı, dengeleme ve yöneltme işlevleriyle birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tarihsel gemi bölümünün modern tek bir parça adıyla kesin eşleştirilmesi gerekmediğinde açıklayıcı karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Geminin kıçındaki yerini ve denge sağlama işlevini kesin olmayan tür eşleştirmesi yapmadan korur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odaktaki parça kıçta denge ve yön sağlar; komşudaki sırık dışarıdan su tabanına dayanarak gemiyi ileri iter.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal gemiyi dengeleyen ve yönelten parçayı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal gemicinin bir sırıkla gemiyi itme eylemini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de geminin hareketinin insan eliyle denetlenmesi olayında yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak bir gemi parçasıdır; komşu ise ayrı bir araçla yapılan itme hareketidir, bu nedenle yalnız aynı olay alanını paylaşırlar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal geminin çalkantısını azaltan belirli kıç bölümünü veya aracını gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal herhangi bir şeyin durmasını veya az hareket etmesini ve geminin denizde beklemesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Geminin hareketinin azalması iki dalın gemi bağlamında buluştuğu sonuçtur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak bu sonucu sağlayan belirli araçtır; komşu ise aracın türünden bağımsız olarak ortaya çıkan durma veya az hareket durumudur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi. Seçilen üç kart gemi donanımı, itme eylemi ve durma sonucu arasındaki sınırı gösterir; diğerleri gemi türleri, geminin bütünü veya uzak kök dallarıdır.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس السكين المدية ولا السكن أهل الدار
